## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows policy (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, `hotfix/*`, `release/*`, `development`, `develop`, `master`)
- [ ] PR title follows conventional format (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `style:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes locally
- [ ] I tested the main flow impacted by this change
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are committed
- [ ] If dependencies changed, `package-lock.json` is included
- [ ] Changelog policy followed:
  - [ ] If target is `release/sprint-*` or `master`, `docs/CHANGELOG.md` updated
  - [ ] If target is any other branch, `docs/CHANGELOG.md` not changed
